statement: For the selected characterization profiles, the benchmark supports a scoped complementarity conclusion: CHAMEO provides explicit characterization-methodology structures, while H₂KG provides greater native class coverage at the predefined profile granularity together with direct valued-parameter and individually provenance-linked result patterns.
scope: The 12/13 and 10/13 values are requirement-satisfaction rates under this frozen protocol, not general ontology-accuracy or quality scores. The benchmark covers eight source records representing seven unique profiles; governance, maintainability, reasoning performance, usability, and scalability were not measured.
